title: "`r params$ticker` Price Report"
output: html_document
params:
  ticker: "TICKER"
  ticker_data: NULL
  sector_name: "Sector"
  subsector_name: "Subsector"
  industry_name: "Industry"
  n_sector_stocks: 0
  n_subsector_stocks: 0
  n_industry_stocks: 0
  sector_median_drawdown: NULL
  subsector_median_drawdown: NULL
  industry_median_drawdown: NULL
  valuation_data: NULL
  valuation_metric_name: "EV to NOPAT"
  valuation_n_sector_stocks: 0
  valuation_n_subsector_stocks: 0
  valuation_n_industry_stocks: 0
  roic_data: NULL
  roic_n_sector_stocks: 0
  roic_n_subsector_stocks: 0
  roic_n_industry_stocks: 0
  anomaly_data: NULL
  momentum_anomaly_data: NULL
  dupont_anomaly_data: NULL
  rolling_beta_data: NULL
  decomposition_data: NULL
  decomposition_metric_display_name: "NOPAT"
  decomposition_numerator: "price"
  decomposition_base_date: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set_ggplot_theme()
```

## Price Decomposition

```{r decomposition-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (!is.null(params$decomposition_data) && nrow(params$decomposition_data) > 0) {
  plot_price_decomposition(
    decomposition_data = params$decomposition_data,
    ticker = params$ticker,
    base_date = params$decomposition_base_date,
    metric_display_name = params$decomposition_metric_display_name,
    numerator = params$decomposition_numerator
  )
}
```

## Cumulative Return

```{r return-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_cumulative_return(
  params$ticker_data,
  params$ticker,
  sector_name = params$sector_name,
  subsector_name = params$subsector_name,
  industry_name = params$industry_name,
  n_sector_stocks = params$n_sector_stocks,
  n_subsector_stocks = params$n_subsector_stocks,
  n_industry_stocks = params$n_industry_stocks
)
```

## Drawdown from Highs

```{r drawdown-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_drawdown(
  params$ticker_data,
  params$ticker,
  sector_median_drawdown = params$sector_median_drawdown,
  subsector_median_drawdown = params$subsector_median_drawdown,
  industry_median_drawdown = params$industry_median_drawdown,
  sector_name = params$sector_name,
  subsector_name = params$subsector_name,
  industry_name = params$industry_name,
  n_sector_stocks = params$n_sector_stocks,
  n_subsector_stocks = params$n_subsector_stocks,
  n_industry_stocks = params$n_industry_stocks
) %>%
  add_data_callout(label_fn = scales::percent)
```

## Rolling Beta

```{r rolling-beta-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_rolling_beta(
  params$rolling_beta_data,
  params$ticker,
  sector_name = params$sector_name,
  n_sector_stocks = params$n_sector_stocks
)
```

## Valuation and ROIC

```{r valuation-roic-charts, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
p_valuation <- plot_valuation_ratio(
  params$valuation_data,
  params$ticker,
  metric_name = params$valuation_metric_name,
  sector_name = params$sector_name,
  subsector_name = params$subsector_name,
  industry_name = params$industry_name,
  n_sector_stocks = params$valuation_n_sector_stocks,
  n_subsector_stocks = params$valuation_n_subsector_stocks,
  n_industry_stocks = params$valuation_n_industry_stocks
)

p_roic <- plot_roic(
  params$roic_data,
  params$ticker,
  sector_name = params$sector_name,
  subsector_name = params$subsector_name,
  industry_name = params$industry_name,
  n_sector_stocks = params$roic_n_sector_stocks,
  n_subsector_stocks = params$roic_n_subsector_stocks,
  n_industry_stocks = params$roic_n_industry_stocks
)

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_valuation, p_roic, ncol = 2)
```

## ROIC vs Valuation

```{r anomaly-roic, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
envelope_roic <- fit_elliptic_envelope(
  params$anomaly_data$roic_pct,
  params$anomaly_data$ev_nopat,
  contamination = 0.1,
  winsorize_pct = 0.02
)

plot_elliptic_envelope(
  data = params$anomaly_data,
  x_col = "roic_pct",
  y_col = "ev_nopat",
  ticker_col = "ticker",
  group_col = "subsector",
  target_ticker = params$ticker,
  target_group = params$subsector_name,
  envelope_fit = envelope_roic,
  x_label = "ROIC",
  y_label = "EV to NOPAT",
  x_pct_labels = TRUE,
  n_sector_stocks = params$valuation_n_sector_stocks,
  n_subsector_stocks = params$valuation_n_subsector_stocks,
  sector_name = params$sector_name,
  subsector_name = params$subsector_name
)
```

## Momentum Divergence

```{r anomaly-momentum, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
envelope_momentum <- fit_elliptic_envelope(
  params$momentum_anomaly_data$ttm_return,
  params$momentum_anomaly_data$return_3m,
  contamination = 0.1,
  winsorize_pct = 0.02
)

plot_elliptic_envelope(
  data = params$momentum_anomaly_data,
  x_col = "ttm_return",
  y_col = "return_3m",
  ticker_col = "ticker",
  group_col = "subsector",
  target_ticker = params$ticker,
  target_group = params$subsector_name,
  envelope_fit = envelope_momentum,
  x_label = "TTM Return (%)",
  y_label = "3-Month Return (%)",
  x_pct_labels = TRUE,
  y_pct_labels = TRUE,
  n_sector_stocks = params$n_sector_stocks,
  n_subsector_stocks = params$n_subsector_stocks,
  sector_name = params$sector_name,
  subsector_name = params$subsector_name
)
```

## Operating Margin vs Asset Turnover

```{r anomaly-dupont, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
envelope_dupont <- fit_elliptic_envelope(
  params$dupont_anomaly_data$operating_margin,
  params$dupont_anomaly_data$asset_turnover,
  contamination = 0.1,
  winsorize_pct = 0.02
)

plot_elliptic_envelope(
  data = params$dupont_anomaly_data,
  x_col = "operating_margin",
  y_col = "asset_turnover",
  ticker_col = "ticker",
  group_col = "subsector",
  target_ticker = params$ticker,
  target_group = params$subsector_name,
  envelope_fit = envelope_dupont,
  x_label = "Operating Margin (%)",
  y_label = "Asset Turnover (x)",
  subtitle = "Excludes stocks with negative operating income",
  x_pct_labels = TRUE,
  n_sector_stocks = params$n_sector_stocks,
  n_subsector_stocks = params$n_subsector_stocks,
  sector_name = params$sector_name,
  subsector_name = params$subsector_name
)
```
